title: Companion D07 integration before healthy control removal
description: Approved D07 Boot 1. One already launched owned app; no cold restart, provider launch, native command or UI/cache injection. Existing native screens, canonical observations, owning private writes, actual errors/Retry and lifecycle events supply proof. Cold and authority proofs are reused under the explicit lead disposition.

proofTargets.claim: Independent project changes move an unlinked candidate into and out of the actual selected project scope.
A disabled rule owning write changes its real mounted native card and canonical observed query.
A real stopped Co-Pilot configuration write advances its canonical native query while the existing screen remains mounted.
Real PR and checkout-source errors retain facts, render errors, accept Retry and recover through owning source repairs.
The same native process backgrounds and reconnects in the same epoch, showing a source change made while away without replay.

integration-ready.intent: Attach to the existing Backlog screen on the one reserved device.

prove.intent: Prove native source updates, errors, Retry and background recovery.

d07-filtered-membership.intent: Show project changes add and remove the same filtered native row.

d07-pr-writer.intent: Show the disabled rule change through its owning write and current query.

d07-copilot-writer.intent: Bind stopped Co-Pilot configuration to the actual native query.

d07-errors-retry.intent: Show real source errors, actual Retry and recovery without commands.

d07-background.intent: Show the same app recover a background source write without replay.
